title: File:Black Canyon National Recreation Trail marker at Emery Henderson Trailhead (53696553448).jpg
claims: The image shows a metal Black Canyon National Recreation Trail marker standing in gravel at Emery Henderson Trailhead, with hiker, equestrian and bicycle symbols and a closed-to-motor-vehicles notice.

The Commons description identifies the marker at Emery Henderson Trailhead north of Phoenix and credits Michelle Ailport / Bureau of Land Management Arizona; it is a trailhead sign, not a race-day photograph, and shows no start/finish arch, timing mat, aid table or runner.
The author is BLMArizona; the file is public domain; the photograph was taken on 2024-05-03; the original is 4,749 x 3,166 pixels and 16,169,248 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 381,995 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits BLM Arizona / Michelle Ailport, public domain, Wikimedia Commons.
